summary: Electra is one of the Pleiades and a daughter of Atlas. By Zeus on Samothrace she bore Iasion and Dardanus. She is distinct from Electra daughter of Agamemnon and from the Oceanid Electra.

sections.heading: Mythology
paragraphs: Apollodorus counts Electra among the Pleiades and reports that she bore Iasion and Dardanus to Zeus on Samothrace (Bibliotheca 3.10.1, 3.12.1).
Hyginus preserves the star-myth of her grief for Troy on the hero node `electra-atlas` (Fabulae 192).
